label: POST HOC addendum 2, EXPLORATORY (exposed data). Requested by the parent after the feedback_eval results were seen (U_screen_post strongest existing comparator on the same-condition target; its matched no-feedback control was not reported). Not part of the registered diagnostic decision; no verdict.
question: Is U_screen_post's advantage attributable to feedback? Compare it with its matched no-feedback control U_screen_static, and U_lambda with U_V0, on the identical campaigns and eligible sets.

definitions.U_screen_static: S0 = frozen TransferWorld(WorldConfig(context=False)) prior mean on the screen scale (world.prior_target), the world fitted exactly as for U_screen_post (role panel, HD lines + target; E campaigns exclude every other E line); no purchased label enters
definitions.U_screen_post: S0 + F (F = posterior mean - prior mean given R's purchased round-1 screen labels)
definitions.U_V0: shrunk history mean of the verification label (L_v score)
definitions.U_lambda: U_V0 + lambda x F, lambda = 0.36615008975859115 from design/feedback_fit.json (HD fit, unchanged)
definitions.campaigns: exactly those of the feedback_eval stage: role-swapped E = 61 E lines x 2 roles (122); same-condition = 14 repeat lines x 2 roles (28), chrono seeding events R1 (screen) / R2 (verification), eligible menu = finite R1 and R2
definitions.eligible_set: the campaign's unscreened candidates after R's P3 round 1 (identical for all four rankings)

endpoints.AUC: per campaign AUC (rounded score, ties 0.5) among eligible candidates against the realised joint call; undefined if 0 or all joint hits; line = mean over defined roles
endpoints.log_loss: undefined for all four (continuous label-scale predictions, not probabilities): reported as null with the reason; no post hoc probability mapping is fitted
endpoints.P3_yield: confirmed discoveries under P3 (measurement cap) with R's round 1, R's verify order p_v|s and reserve p_s, round-2 screen order by the ranking (identical machinery to feedback_eval)

contrasts: P3 confirmed yield for the same two pairs
definitions.inference: contract bootstrap: rng = default_rng(20261004), lines sorted by SIDM within tissue (Breast, Colon, Pancreas), 10,000 resamples of rng.integers(0, n_t, n_t) per tissue, percentile [2.5, 97.5]; for AUC over the lines where both rankings are defined (fresh indices for that line set)
targets_reported_separately: same_condition_HD (6) and same_condition_E (8) as descriptive splits

reproduction_check: AUC, P3 confirmed and frozen-prediction hashes of U_screen_post, U_lambda, U_V0 must equal the stored per-campaign values in results/feedback_eval_20261004_130535 (counted; any mismatch reported)
synthetic_test: scratchpad test on the frozen builder's synthetic release (10 lines, 12 drugs), 2026-10-04 ~15:53: 20 E campaigns; U_screen_post / U_lambda / U_V0 AUC, P3 yield and prediction hashes identical to feedback.evaluate_campaign (60/60); U_screen_static invariant to revealed labels and equal to world.prior_target; poisoned unpurchased outcomes give identical purchases; spend <= cap; no round-3 screens; identical round 1. PASS.
command: python -m research.astra.confirmation_campaign_20261004.design.addendum_2_screen_static (one new exposed_ticket; output design/results/addendum2_<stamp>/, never overwritten)
